themes.missing_en: Unresolved: reviewed participation, issuer economics, market context, contrary evidence, next condition. The cited allocation section covers integrated air and missile defense; a Golden Dome program allocation is not established. Conditional: if the allocation plan advances to funded, scope-specific contracts, verified contractor participation could become orders and later revenue. Margin and cash would still depend on contract terms, execution costs and payment timing. Issuer allocation, workshare and common-shareholder cash are unknown.
themes.missing_zh: 尚未解决：已审查参与关系、发行人财务、市场背景、相反证据、下一条件。 所引分配章节涵盖综合防空及导弹防御；尚未确认Golden Dome项目分配。条件情景：若分配计划推进至已获资金、范围明确的合同，已核实承包商的参与才可能转为订单及后续收入。利润率与现金仍取决于合同条款、执行成本及付款时间。发行人分配、项目份额及普通股股东现金均未知。
themes.next_en: Invalidation: funding does not advance, the awarded scope names a different supplier, or disclosed execution costs offset the demand benefit. Confirm the program, contractor and contract stage before assigning economics.
themes.next_zh: 失效条件：资金未推进、获授范围由其他供应商承担，或披露的执行成本抵销需求收益。先确认项目、承包商及合同阶段，再判断财务传导。

sources.title: FY2026 Mandatory Funding Allocation Plan — SEC. 20003

themes.known_en: Enhancement of Department of Defense Resources for Munitions and Defense Supply Chain Resiliency: allocation-plan context; it does not prove obligation, outlay, order or revenue. Lockheed Martin: reported segment evidence is available for 2026Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. RTX: reported segment evidence is available for 2026Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. Northrop Grumman reported a 68 USD million unfavorable SiAW estimate-at-completion adjustment for Q2 2026. The same disclosure projects higher costs to mature AARGM-ER production and to develop and qualify SiAW, and reports a favorable Sentinel adjustment tied to contract incentives as a partial offset. This is disclosed cost and execution context, not installed capacity, unit throughput or future profitability. LMT Missiles and Fire Control 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 4101.0 USD million, operating profit 594.0 USD million, margin 14.5 %. RTX Raytheon 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 8269.0 USD million, operating profit 1042.0 USD million, margin 12.6 %.
themes.known_zh: Enhancement of Department of Defense Resources for Munitions and Defense Supply Chain Resiliency：资金分配计划背景；它不能证明义务支出、实际支付、订单或收入。 Lockheed Martin：已有2026Q2报告分部证据。它不代表项目份额或股东获益。 RTX：已有2026Q2报告分部证据。它不代表项目份额或股东获益。 Northrop Grumman披露2026年第二季度SiAW预计完工成本不利调整为6800万美元。同一披露预计AARGM-ER生产成熟化及SiAW开发与认证的成本上升，并披露与合同激励挂钩的Sentinel有利调整作为部分抵销。这属于已披露成本与执行背景，不代表已安装产能、单位产量或未来盈利能力。 LMT Missiles and Fire Control 2026Q2报告基准：销售额 4101.0 百万美元、营业利润 594.0 百万美元、利润率 14.5 %。 RTX Raytheon 2026Q2报告基准：销售额 8269.0 百万美元、营业利润 1042.0 百万美元、利润率 12.6 %。
themes.missing_en: Unresolved: reviewed participation, market context, next condition. Conditional: funded replenishment orders could raise deliveries only within verified contractor scope. If production scales without matching cost escalation, segment profit could improve; inventory, supplier payments and ramp investment could absorb cash first. The reported segments are baselines, not munitions revenue or a known program share.
themes.missing_zh: 尚未解决：已审查参与关系、市场背景、下一条件。 条件情景：已获资金的补充订单，只有在已核实承包范围内才可能增加交付。若产量扩大而成本未同步攀升，分部利润可能改善；库存、供应商付款及扩产投资可能先占用现金。报告分部仅为基准，并非弹药收入或已知项目份额。
themes.next_en: Invalidation: no qualifying production award or delivery conversion appears, or disclosed costs/charges exceed the ramp benefit. Check contract scope and the next reported sales, margin and cash evidence separately.
themes.next_zh: 失效条件：未出现合格生产合同或交付转化，或披露的成本及费用超过扩产收益。分别核实合同范围，以及下一份报告中的销售、利润率与现金证据。

themes.known_en: Northrop Grumman: reported segment evidence is available for 2026Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. Northrop Grumman: reported segment evidence is available for 2025Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. L3Harris reports the completed majority sale of its commercial space propulsion, power and electronics businesses; broad space demand cannot be attributed wholly to LHX after the sale. This is ownership context, not a measured revenue loss. L3Harris reports approximately 40% retained ownership in Rocketdyne and excludes RS-25 operations from the sale. Ownership share is not program workshare or revenue share. NOC Space Systems 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 2753.0 USD million, operating profit 236.0 USD million, margin 8.6 %. NOC Space Systems 2025Q2 reported baseline: sales 2646.0 USD million, operating profit 280.0 USD million, margin 10.6 %. NOC GEM63XL 2026Q2 reported baseline: unfavorable estimated completion-cost adjustment 91.0 USD million.
themes.known_zh: Northrop Grumman：已有2026Q2报告分部证据。它不代表项目份额或股东获益。 Northrop Grumman：已有2025Q2报告分部证据。它不代表项目份额或股东获益。 L3Harris披露已完成商业航天推进、电力及电子业务的多数股权出售；出售后不能将广泛航天需求全部归于LHX。这属于所有权背景，未量化收入损失。 L3Harris披露保留Rocketdyne约40%的股权，RS-25业务不在出售范围内。股权比例不等于项目份额或收入份额。 NOC Space Systems 2026Q2报告基准：销售额 2753.0 百万美元、营业利润 236.0 百万美元、利润率 8.6 %。 NOC Space Systems 2025Q2报告基准：销售额 2646.0 百万美元、营业利润 280.0 百万美元、利润率 10.6 %。 NOC GEM63XL 2026Q2报告基准：不利完工成本估计调整 91.0 百万美元。
themes.missing_en: Unresolved: funding stage, reviewed participation, market context, next condition. In the cited NOC Space Systems quarter, sales rose while operating profit and margin fell versus the prior-year quarter. Higher sales did not translate into higher segment profit. These reported segment comparisons do not establish program workshare, capacity, cash generation or shareholder capture. The separately reported GEM63XL adjustment concerns estimated completion costs; its amount does not establish cash paid or HALO's financial effect.
themes.missing_zh: 尚未解决：资金阶段、已审查参与关系、市场背景、下一条件。 所引NOC Space Systems季度销售额上升，但营业利润与利润率下降，比较基准为上年同期。销售额增长未转化为更高的分部利润。这些报告分部比较不能证明项目份额、产能、现金生成或股东获益。 另行报告的GEM63XL调整涉及预计完工成本；该金额不能确认已支付现金或HALO的财务影响。
themes.next_en: Invalidation: the program or retained business scope is not established, or disclosed cost/schedule changes undermine conversion. Confirm the exact program and current owner before interpreting the next financial report.
themes.next_zh: 失效条件：项目或保留业务范围未获确认，或披露的成本及进度变化削弱转化。解读下一份财报前，先核实具体项目及当前业务所有者。

themes.known_en: Spain – F-100 Frigate Mid-Life Upgrade: congressional notification with an estimated upper bound; later implementation is not observed. It does not prove an award or contracted revenue. NATO spending commitment is policy context; it does not prove national appropriations, orders or contracted issuer revenue. Contractor names are printed in the official notice; their issuer attribution is not reviewed.
themes.known_zh: Spain – F-100 Frigate Mid-Life Upgrade：国会通知及估计上限；尚未观察到后续实施，不能证明合同授予或合同收入。 北约支出承诺属于政策背景；它不能证明国家拨款、订单或发行人收入。 官方通知列出了承包商名称；其发行人归属尚未审查。
themes.missing_en: Unresolved: reviewed participation, issuer economics, market context, contrary evidence. Conditional: policy commitments and the Spain F-100 notification could become demand only through national funding and an offered/accepted/implemented agreement, then verified contracts. Margin and cash would depend on the contracted mix and payment terms. The notification ceiling is not issuer revenue; contractor attribution and capture remain unreviewed.
themes.missing_zh: 尚未解决：已审查参与关系、发行人财务、市场背景、相反证据。 条件情景：政策承诺及西班牙F-100通知，须经各国资金决定、提出／接受／实施协议，再落实已核实合同，才可能转为需求。利润与现金取决于合同组合及付款条款。通知上限并非发行人收入；承包商归属及获益仍未审查。
themes.next_en: Next condition: official evidence of an offered, accepted or implemented letter of offer and acceptance. Invalidation: funding or agreement advancement does not occur, the notified scope changes, or the eventual contractor differs. Follow official agreement evidence before any issuer or financial attribution; no advancement date is asserted.
themes.next_zh: 下一条件：出现已提出、已接受或已实施《要约和接受函》的官方证据。 失效条件：资金或协议未推进、通知范围改变，或最终承包商不同。先追踪官方协议证据，再作发行人或财务归属判断；未断言推进日期。

themes.known_en: Spain – F-100 Frigate Mid-Life Upgrade: congressional notification with an estimated upper bound; later implementation is not observed. It does not prove an award or contracted revenue. Contractor names are printed in the official notice; their issuer attribution is not reviewed.
themes.known_zh: Spain – F-100 Frigate Mid-Life Upgrade：国会通知及估计上限；尚未观察到后续实施，不能证明合同授予或合同收入。 官方通知列出了承包商名称；其发行人归属尚未审查。
themes.missing_en: Unresolved: reviewed participation, issuer economics, market context, contrary evidence. Conditional: the Spain F-100 upgrade notification could support service or equipment demand only after agreement advancement and a reviewed contract/contractor path. Recurring support and one-time upgrades could have different margins; timing, inventory and customer payments could separate revenue from cash. No contractor mix or issuer capture is established.
themes.missing_zh: 尚未解决：已审查参与关系、发行人财务、市场背景、相反证据。 条件情景：西班牙F-100升级通知，只有在协议推进、合同及承包商路径审查后，才可能支持服务或设备需求。持续维护与一次性升级的利润率可能不同；时间、库存及客户付款可能使收入与现金分离。承包组合及发行人获益尚未确认。
themes.next_en: Next condition: official evidence of an offered, accepted or implemented letter of offer and acceptance. Invalidation: no implementation evidence appears, the upgrade/support scope changes, or the named contractor is not qualified. Confirm agreement stage, contractor identity and contract mix before comparing financial outcomes.
themes.next_zh: 下一条件：出现已提出、已接受或已实施《要约和接受函》的官方证据。 失效条件：未出现实施证据、升级／维护范围改变，或具名承包商未获核验。比较财务结果前，先确认协议阶段、承包商身份及合同组合。

themes.known_en: Enhancement of Department of Defense Resources for Shipbuilding: allocation-plan context; it does not prove obligation, outlay, order or revenue. Virginia (SSN-774) class attack submarine program: reviewed prime contractor. Participation does not establish program revenue share. Electric Boat Corporation: reviewed ownership path; this is not program workshare. General Dynamics: reported segment context for 2026Q2; no program allocation is asserted. General Dynamics reports Marine Systems unfunded backlog of 22,826 USD million for 2026Q2. This reported category does not establish funded orders, cancellation or forecast revenue. General Dynamics Marine Systems 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 4660.0 USD million, operating profit 342.0 USD million, margin 7.3 %, funded backlog 42356.0 USD million, unfunded backlog 22826.0 USD million, total backlog 65182.0 USD million, estimated potential contracts 7442.0 USD million, total estimated contracts 72624.0 USD million.
themes.known_zh: Enhancement of Department of Defense Resources for Shipbuilding：资金分配计划背景；它不能证明义务支出、实际支付、订单或收入。 Virginia (SSN-774) class attack submarine program：已审查的主承包商关系。参与不代表项目收入份额。 Electric Boat Corporation：已审查的所有权路径；这不代表项目份额。 General Dynamics：2026Q2报告分部背景；未断言任何项目分配。 General Dynamics披露2026Q2Marine Systems未获资金积压订单为22,826百万美元。此报告类别不能证明已获资金订单、取消订单或预测收入。 General Dynamics Marine Systems 2026Q2报告基准：销售额 4660.0 百万美元、营业利润 342.0 百万美元、利润率 7.3 %、已获资金积压 42356.0 百万美元、未获资金积压 22826.0 百万美元、积压总额 65182.0 百万美元、估计潜在合同 7442.0 百万美元、估计合同总额 72624.0 百万美元。
themes.missing_en: Unresolved: market context. Conditional: funded work within the reviewed Virginia/Electric Boat path could convert into deliveries, but GD Marine Systems is a broader segment. Reported funded, unfunded and potential backlog categories are distinct; they are not separate amounts to add to government allocations. Cost/schedule performance and milestone payments could drive margin and cash differently. Virginia workshare and shareholder cash remain unknown.
themes.missing_zh: 尚未解决：市场背景。 条件情景：已审查的Virginia／Electric Boat路径内，已获资金工作可能转为交付，但GD Marine Systems涵盖更广业务。报告的已获资金、未获资金及潜在积压类别各有口径，不能作为独立金额再加到政府分配。成本／进度表现及里程碑付款可能使利润与现金走向不同。Virginia份额及股东现金仍未知。
themes.next_en: AUKUS Pillar 1: first Virginia-class boat sale to Australia (FY2032); schedule remains the owning milestone estimate. Invalidation: reviewed participation changes, funded backlog fails to convert, or disclosed costs/schedule changes weaken profit or cash. Verify the next Marine backlog categories and execution evidence without assigning all segment totals to Virginia.
themes.next_zh: AUKUS Pillar 1: first Virginia-class boat sale to Australia (FY2032)；时间安排仍以原里程碑估计为准。 失效条件：已审查参与关系改变、已获资金积压未转化，或披露的成本／进度变化削弱利润或现金。核实下一期Marine积压分类及执行证据，不把全部分部金额归于Virginia。
